newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean hospital workers to strike.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean hospital workers to strike.

text.p: South Korean hospital workers will strike at key facilities around the nation on Friday, including seven medical centres in Seoul, a union official said.
Kim Gun-ye, a senior official representing hospital unions within the outlawed Korea Confederation of Trade Unions, said so far, unions at 13 hospitals had decided to join the strike.
Among the 13 are Seoul National University Hospital, the nation's leading medical centre, and Ehwa Women's University Hospital.
The unions were responding to call by the outlawed Korea Confederation of Trade Unions to its affiliates to launch an indefinite strike.
Unions at around 140 medical institutions belong to the confederation, Kim said.
Unions at other hospitals were still discussing industrial action, she added.
